verdict.rationale: Docs confirm each product is assigned a Product Tax Category (PTC) that determines taxability per jurisdiction, and that sellers only need to create IDs per unique tax category, with many-to-1 mapping support to map catalog SKUs to Anrok product IDs. However, the evidence never enumerates the specific standard categories (SaaS, digital goods, services, physical products) or shows a UI/API workflow for selecting among them, so the exact mapping experience described in the story is not fully evidenced. Missing for 10: explicit list/taxonomy of vendor tax categories, documentation of how a developer selects/assigns a category per product, and independent/hands-on confirmation of category coverage across jurisdictions.
